name: Wave five after wave four
idea: A signal when the wave four pullback of an impulse may be over and the fifth wave may be starting, by the trigger style you pick; the count is void if wave four reaches the end of wave one.

params.label: Wave timeframe
params.help: The chart where the waves are counted (the minor trend). Not finer than your signal timeframe.

params.label: Higher timeframe
params.help: The chart of the main trend. Not finer than the wave timeframe.

params.label: Wave size
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history.

params.label: Smaller swing size
params.help: The smaller swings inside a wave: they mark the area, the turn of the smaller structure and each new pullback. Smaller than the wave size.

params.label: Higher trend
params.help: With the higher trend: the move the idea expects must point the same way as the swing trend on the higher timeframe.
choice_labels: Only with the higher trend
Any higher trend

params.label: Higher trend swing size
params.help: Which swings on the higher timeframe decide its trend: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest.

params.label: Trigger style
params.help: What turns the setup into a signal. The touch and candle styles look for the area; the others for the smaller structure or the wave's own channel.
choice_labels: The first touch of the area
A reversal candle at the area
The smaller structure turns on your chart
A close beyond the channel of the pullback
The retest of the broken channel

params.label: Area
params.help: Where the touch and candle styles look for the end of the pullback: the zone of the last smaller swing, or no area (then turn on the Fibonacci zone).
choice_labels: Smaller swing zones
No area

params.label: Area width
params.help: How close to the zone the close must be, in median bar ranges.

params.label: Fibonacci zone
params.help: Only when wave four has retraced wave three into this zone (shares of wave three).
choice_labels: Off
Only inside the zone

params.label: Wave four depth: from
params.help: The near edge of the zone, as a share of the wave it is measured against.

params.label: Wave four depth: to
params.help: The far edge of the zone, as a share of the wave it is measured against.

params.label: Count clarity
params.help: An unclear count never gives a signal. Optionally also skip a count whose alternate reading points the other way.
choice_labels: Any count that is not unclear
Not when the alternate count points the other way

params.label: Opportunities
params.help: Only the first opportunity in each wave four, or a new one at every new smaller swing inside it (the newest replaces the older one).
choice_labels: Only the first one per wave
Every new smaller pullback inside the wave

params.label: Pullback watch
params.help: With every new smaller pullback: how many bars of your chart each one is watched for its trigger.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Retest window
params.help: For the retest style: the bars after the break within which the retest must come.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The count's own limit (wave four never reaches the end of wave one), the last smaller swing, the far side of the area (the zone of the last smaller swing, widened by the area width), or whichever of the count's limit and the area's far side is further.
choice_labels: The end of wave one
The last smaller swing
The far side of the area
Whichever is further: the count's limit or the area's far side

params.label: Exit signal
params.help: Optional: when the idea has ended. It is not acted on yet; your own exit settings always apply.
choice_labels: None
The wave structure turns against the idea
The count leaves waves four and five

params.label: RSI divergence
params.help: Optional: also an RSI divergence on the wave chart when the trigger comes. Regular: the last swing went further than the one before but the RSI did not. Hidden: the last swing stopped short of the one before but the RSI went further.
choice_labels: Off
A regular divergence
A hidden divergence

params.label: Divergence swing size
params.help: Which swings of the wave chart the divergence compares: 0 is the smallest (the swings inside a wave); a larger size compares larger swings, up to the waves themselves.

params.label: Divergence age
params.help: How many bars of the wave chart before the trigger the divergence's last swing may be.

params.label: RSI length
params.help: How many bars the RSI of the divergence is measured over.

params.label: Volume
params.help: Optional: wave four on lower volume than wave three, the trigger bar on higher volume than its average, or both. Indices have no volume: leave this off for an index (it would never confirm).
choice_labels: Off
Wave four on lower volume than wave three
The trigger bar on higher volume
Both

params.label: Trigger bar volume
params.help: For the trigger bar volume: at least this many times its average volume.

constraints.message: The wave timeframe must not be finer than your signal timeframe.
The higher timeframe must not be finer than the wave timeframe.
The smaller swings must be smaller than the waves.
The Fibonacci zone must start before it ends.
Pick an area or turn on the Fibonacci zone: the touch and candle styles need one.

first.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to))
first.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to))

every.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to)) AND (SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf} < Lag(SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1) OR SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf} > Lag(SwingLow($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1))
every.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")) AND ($fib_zone == "none" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} >= $fib_from AND WaveRatio($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $fib_to) OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) >= $fib_from AND (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "4")@{wave_tf}) / (WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} - WaveEnd($wave_degree, "2")@{wave_tf}) <= $fib_to)) AND (SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf} < Lag(SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1) OR SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf} > Lag(SwingHigh($area_degree)@{wave_tf}, 1))

candle.long: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND ($area_source == "none" OR (SwingZoneDistance("low", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $zone_width AND SwingZoneDistance("low", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} >= -$zone_width)) AND ReversalAt(WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf}, "bullish")
candle.short: WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" AND ($area_source == "none" OR (SwingZoneDistance("high", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} <= $zone_width AND SwingZoneDistance("high", $area_degree)@{wave_tf} >= -$zone_width)) AND ReversalAt(WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf}, "bearish")

choch.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND SwingBreakType("up", $area_degree, $k) == "CHOCH"
choch.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND SwingBreakType("down", $area_degree, $k) == "CHOCH"

breakout.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveLineBreak($wave_degree, "channel_4", "up", $k)@{wave_tf}
breakout.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND WaveLineBreak($wave_degree, "channel_4", "down", $k)@{wave_tf}

retest.long: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} <= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND RetestEntry("up", "wave_line", $retest_bars, true, $wave_degree, "channel_4", "A", $k)@{wave_tf}
retest.short: (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_4" OR (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} >= WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf})) AND RetestEntry("down", "wave_line", $retest_bars, true, $wave_degree, "channel_4", "A", $k)@{wave_tf}
